execution_rule: depends_on is authoritative. Array order guarantees backward dependencies; a later ready step may run in parallel only when allowed_files are disjoint. Step IDs are stable traceability labels and must not be sorted numerically.
objective: Produce a locally verified Synera/CNRA pilot candidate that helps two solo entrepreneurs turn declared complementary needs into an explicitly approved small business collaboration, without autonomous authority over people, money, law, or private data.
current_state: Verified 2026-09-09 after bounded v3 implementation and adversarial repair: the dirty checkout on codex/synera-documentation-refresh contains one deterministic matcher with exchange, paid_service, referral and hybrid candidate semantics; an explicitly versioned matcher output and preserved non-pilot brief-v1 shape; a private non-binding business-case v2; a pure material-terms/version/hash/approval/revocation/expiry gate with authorization-time hash recomputation and pair-participant ownership; and source-separated pilot metrics whose real_authorized value remains a caller label, not authenticated evidence. The complete discovered Node suite passed 97/97 across 11 test files, two P1 semantic tests failed before repair and passed afterward, the earlier case-disclosure mutation failed its semantic test and passed after restoration, and the offline build emitted 26 unpublished files. This is a D1 domain-core result with limits: active UI consent/mode flow, generated persistence proposal, disposable-database RLS proof, current remote state, second-person acceptance, business outcomes, payments, legal review, market demand and ROI remain unaccepted.
success_criteria: One existing comparator supports versioned exchange, paid_service, referral, and hybrid candidate semantics without creating a second matching engine.

A pure versioned pair-case state machine proves two approvals, authorization-time material-hash equality, pair-participant ownership, expiry, revocation and material-change invalidation before its generated persistence proposal is considered; no introduction or messaging may derive from raw discoverability alone.

The product plan names one initial solo-business segment, offer ladder, controlled acquisition channel, manual baseline, full funnel, support-cost record, willingness-to-pay gate and go/repair/pivot/stop decisions.
A meaningful terms change invalidates both approvals; consent withdrawal prevents the next disclosure or introduction.
Synthetic end-to-end tests cover positive and negative cases, privacy projection, role order, stale data, one-way benefit, changed terms, and consent revocation.
The pilot receipt reports denominator-preserving events and never claims market ROI without real measured outcomes.
No deployment, migration, sign-up opening, external message, payment or recording is performed; bounded synthetic provider reviews require exact receipts and never accept their own output.
forbidden_actions: Do not overwrite uncommitted user work or apply the handoff snapshot over the live checkout.
Do not create a second router, matcher, backend, queue, ledger, reputation system, payment system, or autonomous scheduler.
Do not send raw transcript, profile, contacts, secrets, recordings, private text, or repository contents to a hosted provider.
Do not publish, deploy, open registration, apply SQL, send invitations, charge money, record meetings, or make legal/tax/immigration decisions.
Do not state product, security, commercial, legal, or ROI acceptance from a test, model answer, or receipt alone.

validation.method: Focused Node tests and offline build for deterministic changes; independent reviewer gates and synthetic-only end-to-end receipts for workflow claims.
evidence_required: provider receipt if and only if a call was approved
